reasoning_content: This time the prepare step got further, but it failed with "NX DB transaction error: SqliteFailure ... FOREIGN KEY constraint failed" — this is an issue with NX's local DB (cache/daemon state). Probably caused by the nx daemon or `.nx` database getting corrupted from a previous failed run (or running nx in parallel during the first failed attempt). Let's check the full log to see which step failed and try clearing NX's cache/daemon.

action.command: pkill -f "pnpm install" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "nx daemon" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "nx.json" 2>/dev/null; sleep 3; grep -n "✖\|Failed tasks\|error" /tmp/pnpm-install2.log | tail -15
